answer: Resist sybils by making each extra identity a prepaid capital trap. A new agent joins the market orchard only after locking a saffron-priced bond frozen through several settlements, plus a unique epoch challenge that cannot be cloned. If two accounts reuse wording, keys, or attestation patterns, both bonds are slashed and the unlock clock resets. Honest operators pay once; an attacker who floods the reward oasis with sockpuppets must immobilize and risk linearly more capital for every fake seat, turning mass registration into a costly, recoverable-loss attack rather than a free signup rush.
